text:
alex: FYI — noticed a p95 regression on Mixtral MoE after kernel-select v1.3.4 rolled. ~12% p95 increase at seq_len=512, KV miss rate up ~6%.

maria: when did the rollout happen?

alex: canary at 2032103500, prod roll at ~2032103600. Canary had a small bump but we treated it as noise. Prod looks consistently worse.

sam: can you paste the profiler output / router breakdown?

alex: pasted below — pulled from the tracer during a 10k request window.

```
router_latency_ms: p50=9.8 p95=78.6 p99=131.2
kv_lookup_ms: p50=1.2 p95=9.4 p99=22.0
kernel_dispatch_ms: p50=3.1 p95=18.7 p99=40.5
cache_hit_rate: 0.82 -> 0.76 (pre->post)
router_topk_dist_shift: more mass on second/third choices, top1 drop ~4%
flame_hint: router_softmax (fused) shows wider tail after v1.3.4
```

jia: v1.3.4 replaced fused_softmax with the new "softfill" kernel that uses a different reduce path and accumulates in fp16 for perf. Suspect numerical softness reduced logit sharpness, so top-k routing becomes noisier and KV lookup pattern shifts -> more misses and cache churn.

maria: that tracks. If top1 drops we end up dispatching to more experts which increases memory pressure and evictions. Did you see any expert-local cache evictions spikes?

alex: yes — per-expert cache eviction rate doubled in the window. Eviction TTL hasn't changed, but working set per-request increased.

sam: can we quickly test a logit-scale patch to restore sharpness? something like: `scaled_logits = logits * router_logits_scale` before softmax. Try scale=1.08/1.12 to compensate fp16 squish.

jia: quick experiment I ran on canary config: set `router_logits_scale: 1.12` + `adaptive_topk: true` (keeps topk lower when confidence drops). Results on small run: p95 down ~7% vs post-roll, cache hit recovered to 0.80. Not fully back to baseline but close.

alex: nice. paste of the runtime snippet I used to toggle:

```json
{
  "model": "mixtral-moex-v1",
  "router": {
    "topk": 4,
    "adaptive_topk": true,
    "router_logits_scale": 1.12,
    "router_temperature": 0.98
  },
  "kernel_selector": {
    "preferred": "v1.3.3-summod",
    "fallback": "v1.3.4"
  },
  "expert_cache": {
    "per_expert_mb": 8,
    "eviction_threshold": 0.75
  }
}
```

maria: switching kernel selector back to prefer v1.3.3 for warmup + enabling logit scaling seems like the quickest mitigation. Any perf cost to scaling?

jia: negligible — scalar multiply on logits is cheap compared to softmax. The cost is in indirect effects (less multi-expert fanout).

infra-bot: scheduled canary: mixtral-moex-v1 config update -> 10% of traffic at 2032104800. Link: https://canaries/2032104800

deploy-bot: rollout started (canary). Notifying ops.

sam: parallel thought: check batching heuristics — v1.3.4 also changed kernel batch packing heuristics which increased avg batch size for certain seq distributions. That can change head reuse/kv locality. Did we correlate batch size distribution?

alex: yes — avg batch size moved from 6.8 -> 7.4 for those workloads. Might slightly increase KV miss amplification.

maria: plan: 1) enable router_logits_scale=1.12 + adaptive_topk true on canary (done), 2) prefer kernel v1.3.3 for a larger roll window, 3) run 1h profiling job with flame + kv eviction tracing, 4) open follow-up to evaluate kernel softmax implementation and numeric path.

jia: also add metric: `router.top1_frac` and `expert.fanout` to the dashboard so we can quickly spot routing entropy.

alex: posted canary metrics after 20m: p95 down 6.8%, cache hit 0.798, evictions down 22%.

maria: good. if the canary holds for 2h we should rollback the kernel roll and then schedule upstream patch to the softfill accumulate path.

sam: one more item — set `client.max_batch_wait_ms` back to 8 from 5 for the impacted route to keep batch packing stable during the kernel swap.

alex: noted, will file the rollout ticket and assign owners.

maria: assigning to @jia for kernel triage, @sam for batching heuristics checks, @alex for canary monitoring + follow-up. :thumbsup:

alex: creating ticket INF-4123 with details + traces. will update thread with ticket link.

deploy-bot: canary at 10% finished step; metrics look stable.

alex: thanks — updating ops runbook with mitigation steps.

jia: I'll dig into fused_softmax vs softfill numerics tomorrow, adding a micro-test to reproduce router entropy shift.

alex: last: canary end ts=2032105345 — leaving config in place until we get kernel revert scheduled.

maria: thanks everyone.
